title: ShieldVLA: Feasibility-Aware Safety Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.13231v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate strong generalization in robotic manipulation and navigation, but existing fine-tuning methods provide limited safety guarantees. Current approaches primarily rely on Lagrangian optimization that enforces safety through soft penalties on expected cumulative cost, often resulting in residual constraint violations or overly conservative behavior. Moreover, learning safety in visual domains is challenging due to the absence of dense per-step safety annotations. We propose ShieldVLA, a safety-aligned fine-tuning framework for VLA models based on Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability. ShieldVLA learns a model-free approximation of the HJ reachability value function directly from visual observations to estimate the safe operating region. The learned safety critic gates policy optimization by separating reward maximization within feasible regions from recovery near unsafe states, avoiding persistent

translated_title: ShieldVLA：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的可行性感知安全对齐
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作与导航任务中展现出强大的泛化能力，但现有的微调方法仅能提供有限的安全保障。当前方法主要依赖拉格朗日优化，通过对期望累积代价施加软惩罚来强制执行安全性，这往往导致残余的约束违反或过度保守的行为。此外，由于缺乏密集的逐步安全标注，在视觉领域中学习安全性极具挑战性。我们提出了ShieldVLA，一个基于汉密尔顿-雅可比可达性的VLA模型安全对齐微调框架。ShieldVLA直接从视觉观测中学习HJ可达性值函数的无模型近似，以估计安全运行区域。学习到的安全评价器通过对策略优化进行门控，将可行区域内的奖励最大化与不安全状态附近的恢复行为分离开来，从而避免持续性……
tldr: ShieldVLA是一个基于汉密尔顿-雅可比可达性的安全对齐微调框架，通过直接从视觉观测中学习安全评价器来估计安全运行区域，将奖励最大化与危险状态恢复分离，从而为视觉-语言-动作模型提供有效且不过度保守的安全保障。
en_tdlr: ShieldVLA is a safety-aligned fine-tuning framework based on Hamilton-Jacobi reachability that learns a safety critic directly from visual observations to estimate the safe operating region, separating reward maximization from recovery near unsafe states and providing effective yet non-conservative safety guarantees for VLA models.
